meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让配音和背景音乐不再互相盖住,把音量、淡化与效果调到刚好。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频旁白总被背景音乐压住,或需要给多条音轨统一调音。
copy.tagline_en: Balance voiceover against music and shape fades, ducking and effects per track.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your voiceover keeps getting buried by the music and you need it fixed.

howto.what: 给已放在 HyperFrames 合成里的音频做混音：淡入淡出、交叉淡化、轨道音量、音量与效果自动化、人声闪避（ducking/carve）、效果链，以及用 <hf-audio-group> 把多轨汇到一条总线。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成里已放好音频、需要做混音时触发，例如淡入淡出、闪避、效果链等。找或生成音频归 /media-use，片段时序和轨道布局归 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 给音乐床做 voiceover carve，人声组说话时自动闪避
say.note: 在音乐轨上写入 carve 设置、效果链和自动化轨

say.text: 给旁白轨加个 80Hz 的 highpass，去掉隆隆声
把这些旁白片段放进一个 hf-audio-group，共用一条总线
say.note: 多轨共享效果链、推子和自动化时钟

howto.what_en: Mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: fade-in/out, crossfade, track gain/volume, volume and effect automation, ducking/voiceover carve, effect chains (EQ, compressor, limiter), and <hf-audio-group> buses.
howto.when_en: Triggers when audio is already placed in a HyperFrames composition and needs mixing, e.g. fades, ducking, effect chains. Sourcing audio is /media-use; clip timing is /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Carve the music bed under my voiceover group
say_en.note: Writes carve settings, chain and lanes on the bed

say_en.text: Add a highpass at 80 Hz to my narration track
Put these voice clips in one hf-audio-group sharing a bus
say_en.note: One chain, fader and automation clock for all of them
